name: Mazo Harem ~Kako ni Modotte, Uwaki → Harem ni Shiyou!~
original_name: マゾハーレム～過去に戻って、浮気→ハーレムにしよう!～
source:
Toya the capricious masochist had three girls pulling him in different directions.
With a whimsical blessing from above, he was taken back to in time... can he succeed in turning all their ab*ses into a group thing?
